# Convert a bank CSV to a QBO, OFX or QIF file

> Free bank CSV to QBO, OFX and QIF converter for QuickBooks and Quicken: handles debit/credit columns, US and European dates and decimals, catches bad rows and duplicates, and runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
